title: Nasruddin Tale 171: The Midnight Noise
summary: In the middle of the night, a tremendous crash and clatter echoed from Nasruddin's house, shaking the walls and waking the entire lane....
full_text:
In the middle of the night, a tremendous crash and clatter echoed from Nasruddin's house, shaking the walls and waking the entire lane.

A terrified neighbor pounded on the door: "Mulla, what on earth was that terrifying crash?"

"It was nothing," replied Nasruddin through the window. "My woolen shirt fell down the wooden stairs."

"Can a woolen shirt make a noise like an earthquake?" cried the neighbor.

"Certainly," sighed Nasruddin, "when I am inside the shirt when it tumbles down the stairs!"
moral: Confessing a clumsy stumble with humor averts alarm and panic.
